# Ci

KnotGate's CI tooling. `Tools/_KG/Ci/modules.py` is a layer-aware copy of Wolfgate's module checker;
`Tools/_KG/Ci/modules.yml` names the layer (prefix, marker, the closed migrations folder, the Wolfgate `fork_point`).
`wg-modules.yml` runs it on every pull request, and `publish.yml` publishes to the `knotgate` CDN fork. See
Docs/_KG/Upstream.
